question: ‘The Truths We Hold: An American Journey’ is an autobiography of which political leader?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamala Harris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kamala Harris is the 49th and current Vice President of the United States, serving since January 20, 2021.
 
• She is the first female Vice President and the highest-ranking female official in U.S. history, as well as the first African American and first Asian American Vice President.
 
• Prior to her vice presidency, Harris served as the junior United States Senator from California from 2017 to 2021 and as the Attorney General of California from 2011 to 2017.
 
• Her autobiography, "The Truths We Hold: An American Journey," offers insights into her personal and political journey, discussing her career and the values that have driven her work in public service.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kamala Harris's Background**

 
 
• Kamala Devi Harris was born on October 20, 1964, in Oakland, California, to immigrant parents. Her mother, Shyamala Gopalan, was a breast cancer scientist from India, and her father, Donald Harris, is an economist from Jamaica.
 
• She graduated from Howard University and the University of California, Hastings College of the Law.
 
 
 
• **Political Career**
 
 
• Harris began her career in the Alameda County District Attorney's Office, before being recruited to the San Francisco District Attorney's Office and later the City Attorney of San Francisco's office.
 
• In 2003, she was elected District Attorney of San Francisco. In 2010, she was elected Attorney General of California, being re-elected in 2014.
 
• She was elected to the United States Senate in 2016, becoming the second African American woman and the first South Asian American to serve in the U.S. Senate.
 
 
 
• **Vice Presidency**
 
 
• Kamala Harris was selected by Joe Biden as his running mate for the 2020 United States presidential election. They won the election, defeating the incumbent President Donald Trump and Vice President Mike Pence.
 
• As Vice President, Harris has focused on issues such as immigration, voting rights, and the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
 
 
• **The Truths We Hold: An American Journey**
 
 
• The book was published in January 2019, ahead of her presidential campaign announcement.
 
• It provides a narrative of her upbringing, her career as a prosecutor and politician, and her vision for the future of America.
 
• The autobiography reflects her commitment to justice, equality, and her belief in the importance of public service.
